requirements: Provide CRUD REST endpoints at /notes and /notes/{id}, store notes in SQLite, accept JSON fields title and content, return the created note with HTTP 201, and return a JSON array from GET /notes.
External clients access the API over HTTPS.
Notes must survive container replacement and VM restart.
Mount persistent storage at /var/lib/notes and allocate at least 20 GiB.
High availability is not required; deploy exactly one application VM.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to Azure Korea Central. The monthly infrastructure budget is 150 USD. One availability zone is acceptable. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
